engineeringHealth.reason: The first independent review found missing Resolver replay context for Task 4L typed reload. The bounded noncanonical correction then passed a fresh independent scoped re-review with no P1/P2; implementation is limited to Task 3B's existing persistence allowlist.

acceptanceEvidence: Every historical v1 persisted loadout/snapshot remains readable with identical canonical bytes, keys and row hashes; v1 rows reject non-empty v2 authority/effect fields.

A v2 no-loadout-effect row persists exact empty occurrence evidence and NULL aggregate key without changing Task 4P identity; an active v2 row binds exact aggregate bytes/key and each ordered relation occurrence.
Deferred triggers accept parent/relation insertion in either order in one transaction but reject missing tail, extra, duplicate ordinal, gap, reorder or substituted effect-record relation at commit.

SimulationSnapshotStore reloads the aggregate and ordered records through typed owners, reuses a bounded loadout-side resolver replay context, then calls Task 4P/4L verifiers; no DB/runtime/API/UI/worker consumer is activated.
Fresh and upgrade real PostgreSQL candidates prove migration 0031, append-only and privilege boundaries, and seeded v1 row-hash stability before any runtime evidence promotion.

candidateDeployment.beforeMerge: Run exactly one final-head real PostgreSQL candidate window after local verification and independent CR. It must use new, explicitly identified disposable fresh and upgrade databases; it is not a production migration or runtime deployment.

closureCondition: Task 3B may advance from implementation_allowed only after scoped independent review, fresh local migration/store regressions, one final-head fresh/upgrade real PostgreSQL candidate, exact-head CI, and the Harness closure sequence. decisionLog.decision: The user authorized continuous Exact-first progression. Task 3B is selected as the next fully specified and allowlisted stage after archived Task 3A, Task 4P and Task 4L.
Task 3B preserves the frozen split: Task 3A owns canonical authority documents, Task 4L owns loadout effect authority canonical semantics, and 0031 owns only append-only persistence/reload relations.

After the first independent Task 3B review found the missing replay context, the minimal noncanonical resolver projection was added to the active plan and requirement. A fresh scoped re-review returned PASS with no P1/P2, so only the existing Task 3B persistence allowlist is implementation_allowed.
